## Personality

Milty Boulter is known for his ability to explain things and takes great pride in his mother's resourcefulness. However, he is also regarded by others as being quite mean.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Davy P16](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0016)_

## History

Milty Boulter had been attending school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a year, considering himself quite a man of the world. He remained a pupil in the local schoolroom alongside [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, where he was taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) until her resignation to attend college. Later, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) detailed some of Milty's misadventures and funny incidents at school in a letter that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) read aloud to her friends at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P6](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0006), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), +78 more_
